code: const BASE='http://localhost:3001/api';export async function fetchBooks(){const res=await fetch("".concat(BASE,"/books"));return res.json();}export async function addBook(data){const res=await fetch("".concat(BASE,"/books"),{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify(data)});return res.json();}export async function updateBook(id,data){const res=await fetch("".concat(BASE,"/books/").concat(id),{method:'PUT',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify(data)});return res.json();}export async function deleteBook(id){const res=await fetch("".concat(BASE,"/books/").concat(id),{method:'DELETE'});return res.json();}export async function fetchLinks(bookId){const res=await fetch("".concat(BASE,"/books/").concat(bookId,"/links"));return res.json();}export async function addLink(bookId,data){const res=await fetch("".concat(BASE,"/books/").concat(bookId,"/links"),{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify(data)});return res.json();}export async function deleteLink(linkId){const res=await fetch("".concat(BASE,"/links/").concat(linkId),{method:'DELETE'});return res.json();}
